<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, peaks at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm fall in the aromatic region, while the 168.60 ppm peak is a carbonyl carbon. The presence of only two distinct aromatic carbon signals suggests a symmetric para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which contains four aromatic carbons (two equivalent ortho and two equivalent meta carbons). Therefore, the molecule has 4 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
